description: TMR Bicycle Counts is a dataset listed in Queensland Government open data portal (data.qld.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Transport and Main Roads. Bicycle counts from the TMR Active Transport program. Various loggers have been positioned around Queensland to count bicycle numbers. Data notes and limitations: • Counts may include some personal mobility devices (PMDs), such as e-scooters and other small, wheeled mobility devices. Coverage: Queensland. The portal files it under the publisher Transport and Main Roads. Its tags are TMR, active transport, bicycle counts, bike counts. It offers 10 resource(s) in csv, pdf. The portal shows 2026-09-04 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-queensland-government-open-data-portal.
